text:
elaine: Heads-up — RC cutoff in ~3h (21:00 UTC). Code freeze except for approved exceptions. If you need a late merge, post: PR link, owner, risk (low/med/high), and rollback plan. We'll triage until 20:30 UTC.

sam: Quick Q — doc-only changelog bump needs an exception? :thinking_face:

jordan: doc-only generally fine, but still request an exception so we can track it. Tag @release and include changelog snippet.

mira: PR 7890 is a tiny changelog + version bump (no code). Owner: mira. Risk: low. Reason: include missing note for storage edge-case. Rollback: revert cherry-pick. Want approval to merge now.

elaine: Please use this template when posting requests — helps triage faster. Example:

mira: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/7890
Owner: mira
Risk: low
Reason: docs + version stamp
Rollback: `git revert -m 1 <merge-commit>` then `git push origin HEAD:release/v1.5`

release-bot: deploybot: Exception request received for PR 7890 by mira — queued for triage and label assignment.

jordan: I looked quickly — low risk, approve. @eng-oncall can you run a quick staging smoke? If green, we allow merge.

tom: Running staging smoke now. ETA ~8m. Will post results here.

tom: staging smoke: all critical flows (inference, auth, checkout) ✅. No regressions observed.

mira: Rebased, CI passed. Ready to merge after release label.

elaine: OK — all set. I'll add `release/exception-approved` label and unblock merge. Reminder: high-risk changes will be denied past cutoff; plan a hotpatch window tomorrow for larger fixes.

sam: Thanks — good to know. :thumbsup:

jordan: Note for owners: include rollback commands in PR description going forward. Saves time during triage.

mira: will do.

elaine: Closing thread — merge window open until 20:30 UTC for exceptions. After that, only emergency hotpatches via oncall.
